mapper.select: SELECT status AS state, count(*) AS total FROM sessions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND archived_at IS NULL AND status IN ('running', 'rescheduling') GROUP BY status

SELECT count(*) AS total FROM sessions s WHERE s.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.archived_at IS NULL AND s.status = 'running' AND s.updated_at < #{staleBefore} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM session_events e WHERE e.workspace_uuid = s.workspace_uuid AND e.session_uuid = s.uuid AND e.deleted_at IS NULL AND e.created_at >= #{staleBefore} )

SELECT COALESCE(worker_status, 'unknown') AS worker_status, connection_status AS connection_status, count(*) AS total FROM code_sessions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'active' GROUP BY COALESCE(worker_status, 'unknown'), connection_status
SELECT state AS state, count(*) AS total FROM environment_work WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND state IN ('queued', 'starting', 'active', 'stopping') GROUP BY state

SELECT COALESCE(CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MIN(COALESCE(queued_at, created_at)))) AS bigint), 0) AS age_seconds FROM environment_work WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND state = 'queued' AND COALESCE(queued_at, created_at) <= NOW()
SELECT count(*) AS total FROM environment_work WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND state = 'starting' AND updated_at < #{startedBefore}

SELECT CASE WHEN worker_claim_expires_at > NOW() THEN 'claimed' ELSE 'waiting' END AS state, count(*) AS total FROM code_sessions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'active' AND metadata #>> '{config,worker_transport}' = 'claim' AND worker_claim_requested_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1

SELECT count(*) AS total FROM code_sessions cs JOIN sessions s ON s.uuid = cs.session_uuid AND s.organization_uuid = cs.organization_uuid AND s.workspace_uuid = cs.workspace_uuid AND s.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE cs.deleted_at IS NULL AND cs.status = 'active' AND cs.metadata #>> '{config,worker_transport}' = 'claim' AND cs.worker_claim_requested_at IS NULL AND (cs.worker_claim_expires_at IS NULL OR cs.worker_claim_expires_at <= NOW()) AND (cs.worker_lease_expires_at IS NULL OR cs.worker_lease_expires_at < NOW()) AND s.status IN ('running', 'rescheduling')

SELECT COALESCE(CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MIN(worker_claim_requested_at))) AS bigint), 0) AS age_seconds FROM code_sessions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'active' AND metadata #>> '{config,worker_transport}' = 'claim' AND worker_claim_requested_at IS NOT NULL AND (worker_claim_expires_at IS NULL OR worker_claim_expires_at <= NOW())
SELECT state AS state, count(*) AS total FROM environment_sandboxes WHERE state IN ('creating', 'running', 'stopping') GROUP BY state
